mechanism_narrative: A higher current CPIAUCSL (inflation index) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated inflation erodes real earnings and increases the risk of monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 275, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, the market anticipates monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors sell equities to reduce risk exposure.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 0.5%) and a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) creates a 'high inflation, low rate' regime that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as the market anticipates forced monetary tightening without immediate relief.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500 thousand units and industrial production (INDPRO) rises above 100, it indicates a late-cycle economic expansion where the housing sector is slowing but manufacturing remains strong, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in an impending Fed response to cooling housing.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, the market anticipates monetary policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate lower interest rates and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 102, it signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 102, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a rising labor force (PAYEMS MoM > 0.5%) and falling unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates sustained economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceed 640000 million dollars, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in robust economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 640000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
